title: Hoover on a Short Rope?
blurb: The Bloomington QB debate: Grant Wilson looked better than Josh Hoover off the bench (9-of-17 vs. Minnesota) — but if Hoover has actually been hurt, he starts against USC on a very short rope.

title: Take the Couch Saturday
blurb: Probably the biggest college football slate they've ever seen — drop everything, tell the wife it's your day, and take the couch from noon to midnight.

title: Don't Spend? Sell the Team
blurb: MLB lockout talk: the Dodgers and Mets spend infinite money while small markets can't compete — if you don't want to spend, sell the team. A floor is a must, and some form of a cap is coming.

title: Best QB in College Football
blurb: Trinidad Chambliss torched LSU for 363 yards in Ole Miss's win, ruining Lane Kiffin's return to Oxford — and the guys say there's no argument against him as the best QB in college football right now.

title: Marcel Reed Is Bad
blurb: After Kentucky walked into College Station: Marcel Reed is just bad — 26-of-49, two interceptions, no completions beyond 20 yards. The bad stamp is official.

title: Taking Maiava Over Moore
blurb: Preseason, everyone takes Dante Moore. Three weeks in, the pick flips: Jayden Maiava over Moore, with Oregon–USC on deck.

title: Texas A&M Is Overrated
blurb: The A&M take after the Arizona State loss: three picks, two pick-sixes, four turnovers. Overrated.

title: Josh Allen Is a Monster
blurb: Bills–Texans thriller: Josh Allen is just a monster.

title: Chiefs Destroyed the Broncos
blurb: Monday night recap: the Chiefs destroyed the Broncos, and Mahomes is so back.
